about: R242: the series card's and the subscribe animation's timing and placement, one copy for remotion/src/overlays (SeriesCard.tsx, SubscribeCta.tsx) and tools/remotion_ctas.py (and the stage, when it places them). Seconds; frame px at 1920 x 1080.

original.note: the Motion Array clip's own moments (research/backgrounds/refs_ep03/ep03_cta.json): it starts 1.32 s before 'subscribe', its bell is clicked 1.9 s in (as the word ends), its thumb 2.867 s in, it lasts 7.52 s

subscribe.whooshNote: from t0: when each variation's entrance starts moving (the classic's and the brand's on the bell's first frame, as round 7 placed the original's)
subscribe.handRiseNote: the hand fades in this far below the bell and fades out this far below the thumb (the original fades it in and out near the icons); its body stays inside title-safe (y 980)

series.note: spanS: t1 - t0 as QuickArch03; t0S: the intro's moment proposed for Section A (QuickArch03: 0.52 s); whooshAtS: its sound cue (S9, R158), the library's whoosh as the title starts; box: Section A's place (inside title-safe, above the overlay lint's caption band at y 870 and 19 px above the bottom-centre caption, 12 px from the beard on round 7's render)
series.drawnNote: the card draws anything (its plain black base, then the title) from this after t0 to this before t1; goneS is the title's own
